If applicable, add screenshots, video recordings, or browser / server terminal console logs to help explain your problem.

- **Browser:** [e.g. Chrome 132, Firefox 134, Safari 18]
- **Node.js Version:** [e.g. v20.x, v22.x]

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., authentication status, specific AI model selection, project scale).
